title: Public handle: opt-in UserProfile.publicHandle shown on public Messages
description:
Small task of the `homePage` epic (Ryan 2026-10-31: authors on public Messages are user handles, opt-in). Gives each person an optional public handle that the threads export shows instead of any identity.

## Data model (`amplify/data/schema.ts`)
- `UserProfile` gains `publicHandle: a.string()` and a secondary index on `publicHandle` -> query `userProfileByPublicHandle` (new GSI, allowed) for the uniqueness check. Authorization unchanged (`allow.owner()` plus admin; the backend's functions already read every model).
- Validation in one place, `lib/public-handle.ts` with a Python twin `src/papyrus_content/home_page/handles.py` and shared vectors `scripts/fixtures/public-handle-vectors.json`: 3 to 24 characters, `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$`, no `@`, not in a small reserved list (`admin`, `editor`, `ai`, `papyrus`, `anonymous`), unique per site (store lowercase).

## Console UI
- The existing profile settings panel (where `displayName` is edited; find it with `grep -rn displayName components app`) gains a "Public handle" field with the help text: "Shown next to your messages on the public site. Leave empty to be shown as Editor. Never your email." A Lucide `at-sign` icon marks the field; the save button is the panel's existing one. Errors are text ("That handle is taken", "3 to 24 letters, digits and hyphens"), never colour alone.
- Writes go through a custom mutation `setPublicHandle(handle: String)` (`amplify/data/profile-actions.ts`, JS resolver on `UserProfile`: owner only, lowercases, checks the index, writes `publicHandle` and `updatedAt`); `null` clears it.

## Export side (the threads task uses it)
- `home_page/threads.py` reads `UserProfile.publicHandle` by `authorUserProfileId`; nothing else of the profile is read.

## Gherkin (`features_backend/public-handle.feature`, plus a TS spec in the console's test suite)
- "A person sets a public handle and it is shown on their public messages"
- "A person without a handle is shown as Editor"
- "A handle must be 3 to 24 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens and may not contain an at sign"
- "A handle that another person already uses is refused"
- "Clearing the handle returns the person to the anonymous label"
- "No email, sub or UUID appears in the public threads file whether or not handles are set"

## Acceptance
`npx tsc --noEmit`, the console unit tests, behave green; set a handle on newsroom.anth.us and see it on https://anth.us/newsroom/ once the threads task ships.

## Dependencies
None (schema + console). Blocks: the threads task (PPY-06f20f).
